name: Feature Prediction Table Encoding
definition: A lossless compression method for voxelized models that uses statistical feature prediction tables to predict voxel occupancy based on local context, storing only the binary residual between the prediction and the true value.
summary: Feature Prediction Table Encoding is a lossless voxel compression method that predicts occupancy using full-grid contexts with varying strides, differing from Sparse Voxel Octree approaches.
